verdict.rationale: Off-cycle payroll is a fair question for a payroll product like RUN, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions off-cycle, bonus, correction, or termination runs outside the regular schedule. The only run-related items cover recurring payroll (RUN & DONE) and running payroll through online, phone, or mobile channels, which are adjacent rather than the off-cycle capability itself.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run an off-cycle payroll for bonuses, corrections, or terminations outside the regular schedule
